subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 13 upstream action revisions together across secret-bearing, security-scanning, release, and Codex-agent workflows once one stable exact head has passed owner review and required checks?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but automated review cannot authorize the combined third-party execution and credential-boundary change, especially while the security label is protected and the head is still moving.

options.title: Approve one stable exact head
options.body: Wait for rebasing to stop, complete security/release and direct Codex-source review, then approve only if required checks pass on that exact SHA.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token/CodeQL, and Docker-release updates so each trust boundary can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

options.title: Pause the bot PR
options.body: Close or defer this branch if Dependabot access and repeated rebases prevent a stable reviewable head, then regenerate the updates later.

recommendation.title: Approve one stable exact head
recommendation.body: Wait for rebasing to stop, complete security/release and direct Codex-source review, then approve only if required checks pass on that exact SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: This group is the explicit CODEOWNER for the changed CodeQL security workflows and is the best available owner for the trust-boundary decision.
